# Alder

Alder is an embeddable C# expression engine for .NET applications. It evaluates expressions and statement blocks against the .NET types your host exposes through a compiler-style pipeline: parsing, binding, validation, interpretation, optional delegate compilation, Dynamic LINQ adaptation, expression-tree export, execution limits, and generated dispatch for NativeAOT.

## Primary Documents

- [README](README.md): project overview, installation, first examples, execution surfaces, Dynamic LINQ, security policy, execution limits, benchmarks, and integration model.
- [NuGet README](NUGET.md): package-facing summary and examples.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): navigation for concepts, guides, reference, and operations.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): direct answers for evaluation, Dynamic LINQ, NativeAOT, security, and integration boundaries.

## Concepts

- [Architecture](docs/concepts/architecture.md): parse-bind-execute pipeline, backend split, and integration surfaces.
- [Binding system](docs/concepts/binding-system.md): semantic binding, resolved operations, and dynamic runtime dispatch.
- [Compiled backend](docs/concepts/compiled-backend.md): synchronous delegate compilation and expression-tree export.
- [Async execution](docs/concepts/async-execution.md): interpreter-backed async evaluation, await semantics, and cancellation.
- [Dynamic LINQ](docs/concepts/dynamic-linq.md): runtime query composition across in-memory collections, query providers, and async streams.
- [Extended language mode](docs/concepts/extended-language-mode.md): Alder-specific syntax layered over Standard-mode C# semantics.

- [Choose variables and child engines](docs/guides/variables-context-and-child-engines.md): variable scopes, per-call values, and isolated child contexts.

- [Deploy with NativeAOT](docs/guides/nativeaot-deployment.md): generated contexts, type rooting, and AOT deployment checklist.

- [Configuration](docs/reference/configuration.md): `AlderOptions`, `AlderConfig`, registration entry points, and precedence rules.

- [AOT and generated dispatch](docs/operations/aot-and-generated-dispatch.md): typed dispatch, generated contexts, reflection fallback, and AOT constraints.
